subject: POC packaging options and top-up paths for accelerated evaluation
messages:
From: Jessica Lane <jessica@parallaxhealth.com>
To: lauren.bishop@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Cc: 
Date: Sat, 06 Jun 2026 09:10:00 -0700
Subject: Quick ask: 3-week runway or 200k token top-up for POC

Hi Lauren / Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the clinical team dug into the latency and hallucination tests and is keen to run one more integration pass before we decide on a pilot conversion. We have two constrained ask scenarios and would appreciate a quick recommendation:

1) Can we get a 21-day extension on our existing POC (same SKU/throughput) so the integration team finishes E2E tests?

2) Alternatively, what's the cost for a 200k token top-up we can use immediately (would prefer a one-time invoice rather than extending the term). If there's a discount available for immediate purchase that helps justify the spend to our finance lead.

We're evaluating this against a hard deadline for an internal governance review on 6/23, so a solution this week would be ideal. Also flag: we may need a short SLA bump for concurrency while they run heavier batches.

Appreciate any options/constraints — happy to hop on a 20-min call if that's easier.

Best,
Jessica Lane
Director of Clinical Integrations
Parallax Health

Attachments: none
From: lauren.bishop@redwood.com
To: Jessica Lane <jessica@parallaxhealth.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 06 Jun 2026 11:35:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick ask: 3-week runway or 200k token top-up for POC

Hi Jessica — thanks for the context and the timeline. Really excited Parallax is close to a conversion. Below are three pragmatic paths; pick the one that fits your procurement cadence and I’ll route it to finance/ops for a quote: 

Option A — 21-day trial extension (no additional token purchase):
- Add 21 days to the current POC at no extra charge if Parallax agrees to a conversion decision checkpoint call within 7 days of the extension end date.
- Includes 1x 30-minute retrospective with success metrics (no engineering hours).

Option B — 200k token top-up (immediate use):
- One-time top-up applied to your account. Standard list price would be $1,800 for 200k tokens; we can offer a 20% partner-discount bringing it to $1,440 if the order is placed within 5 business days.
- We can add a temporary concurrency bump (+2 reserved workers) for the duration of the token consumption window for an additional setup fee (see engineering caveat below).

Option C — Burstpack (seat-based short surge):
- 7-day burstpack (includes +3 concurrent slots, higher throughput SLA) priced as an add-on. Useful if you need parallel test runners.

Engineering caveat (from our side): David will confirm whether the KV-cache warm-up and temporary concurrency bump will affect latency for your integration — in some cases a short warm-up increases token spend slightly. If you opt for Option B we’ll coordinate the reserved concurrency to minimize impact.

I’ve attached a quick SKU matrix for clarity (POC_SKU_matrix.xlsx). All offers expire in 7 days from this email. If you’d like the discounted top-up, I can send a DocuSign with the invoice + simple SOW.

Would you like me to send Option B with the 20% discount as a one-click DocuSign?

Thanks,
Lauren Bishop
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0167
Redwood Inference

Attachments: POC_SKU_matrix.xlsx (spreadsheet — token tiers, burstpacks, extension rules)
From: david.kim@redwood.com
To: lauren.bishop@redwood.com, Jessica Lane <jessica@parallaxhealth.com>, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Cc: 
Date: Mon, 07 Jun 2026 09:50:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick ask: 3-week runway or 200k token top-up for POC

Quick technical note from infra:
- We recommend Option B (token top-up) for minimal disruption. Extending the time window (Option A) is fine but teams often hit cold-start KV-cache overheads when resuming heavier runs after idle time; that can spike token burn by ~3-7% in worst-case.
- If Parallax expects heavy parallelization during that extra window, request the temporary reserved concurrency bump at purchase time. We can provision +2 workers within 24 hours but it requires a short maintenance window (30m) to rebalance KV shards.
- No change to model variant or quantization is required for either path.

Happy to coordinate a brief sync with your eng lead if helpful.

—David
David Kim
Solutions Architect, Inference Runtime
david.kim@redwood.com
From: lauren.bishop@redwood.com
To: Jessica Lane <jessica@parallaxhealth.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 08 Jun 2026 15:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick ask: 3-week runway or 200k token top-up for POC

Hi Jessica — circling back with a concrete proposal after David’s note. Appreciate the tight governance window; here are two final offers so your finance team can pick one quickly:

Final Offer 1 — 200k token top-up (recommended):
- Price: $1,530 (15% discount off list) if signed within 7 days.
- Includes one-time +2 reserved concurrency bump for up to 10 days (we’ll schedule the 30m maintenance window within your preferred off-hours).
- One short onboarding call with our product engineer to ensure KV warm-up patterns are minimized.
- DocuSign link: https://www.docusign.com/Initiate?envelopeId=PX-0042-EXT

Final Offer 2 — 21-day extension (no charge):
- Add 21 days to your POC at no additional license cost.
- Includes a 60-minute success review with a Solutions Architect and 5 hours of engineering office hours (split across two sessions) to help finalize integration.
- Requirement: Parallax agrees to a conversion checkpoint call within 7 days after the extension ends.

If you want the discounted top-up, I’ll send over the DocuSign and the invoice immediately and route a contact to coordinate the maintenance window. If you prefer the extension, I’ll schedule the review and reserve David’s time for the engineering session.

Thanks — we’ll hold both offers through EOD 6/15.

Best,
Lauren
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
